text.en:
Subsection (e) of section one of Act Numbered Thirty-eight hundred and thirteen, entitled "An
Act making appropriations for public works", is hereby amended by making item twenty-two on page six,
under the heading "Batangas", read as follows:
"22. For the elementary school of Mataasnakahoy ..................... P4,000.00"

Subsection (e) of section one of Act Numbered Thirty-eight hundred and thirteen, entitled "An
Act making appropriations for public works", is hereby amended by making item twenty-four on page
fourteen, under the heading "Ilocos Norte", read as follows:
"24. For the school of the barrio of Sagpatan, Sarrat ................ P1,000.00"

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, January 6, 1933.
